definitions.explanation: Something that is contrary to what one expected or anticipated. Can be used as a na-adjective or as a noun meaning 'unexpectedness.'

examples.japanese: {意外|いがい}な{結果|けっか}だった。
{彼|かれ}が{料理|りょうり}{上手|じょうず}なのは{意外|いがい}だった。
examples.english: It was surprising that he was good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {意外|いがい}にも、{試験|しけん}の{問題|もんだい}は{簡単|かんたん}だった。
examples.english: Surprisingly, the exam questions were easy.
examples.notes: {意外|いがい}にも is an adverbial usage meaning 'surprisingly' or 'contrary to expectations.'

notes:
{意外|いがい} means something is contrary to expectations — either positively or negatively surprising.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意外|いがい}な + noun: unexpected (adjective)
- {意外|いがい}に / {意外|いがい}にも: surprisingly (adverb)
- {意外|いがい}と: unexpectedly, more than expected (colloquial adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意外|いがい}な{結果|けっか}: unexpected result
- {意外|いがい}な{展開|てんかい}: unexpected development
- {意外|いがい}な{事実|じじつ}: surprising fact

CONTRAST WITH {以外|いがい}:
- {意外|いがい}: unexpected, surprising (adjective/noun)
- {以外|いがい}: other than, besides (noun/particle)
These are homophones but have completely different meanings and kanji.
